effect_description_eng:
＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn.
xros_req:
[App Fusion] [Docmon] & [Medicmon]: Cost 0
If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.
link_effect_description_eng: [When Linking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn.
